schmidt_boundary.native_rest_space_scope: The cubic polynomial is asserted only on this d^3=64 Schmidt-support model. In larger native rest spaces, extra orthogonal support may add eigenvalue 1 to P+Q; norm(PQ)=1/4 and P+Q<=5/4 remain the relevant bounds.
schmidt_boundary.statement: For any pure Omega with rho_B=I4/4, its possibly rectangular coefficient matrix obeys C^dagger C=I4/4, so U=2C is an isometry; in the square d=4 normal form it is unitary, and Omega is obtained from (U tensor I)Phi4 by local isometries.
